title: ClaimEnvelope
description: Versioned claim envelope representing an epistemic assertion exchanged between separately governed autonomous agents and projects.

claimId.description: Unique deterministic or content-addressed identifier for this claim envelope.

kind.description: Epistemic category: fact (verifiable evidence), hypothesis (provisional), preference (design goal), decision (authorized principal choice), obligation (binding invariant).

subject.description: Symbol path, API endpoint, interface name, file path, or resource identifier being qualified.

proposition.description: Structured proposition payload describing the invariant, type constraint, or behavioral claim.

scope.description: Repository, branch, commit, and file scope to which this claim applies.

assumptions.description: Explicit premises and environment preconditions under which this claim holds (ATMS assumption labels).

evidence.description: Cryptographic references, test receipts, witness observations, or Porthole capture receipts supporting the claim.

issuer.description: Identity of the agent, principal, and execution engine that formulated the claim.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live freshness window in seconds. 0 indicates perpetual until superseded.

confidence.description: Statistical uncertainty and calibration metrics, strictly distinct from authority/approval.

authority.description: Authority state: draft, proposed, principal_approved (human sign-off), revoked.

dependencies.description: Claim IDs that must remain valid for this claim to hold.

supersedes.description: Prior claim ID retracted or replaced by this claim.

disclosurePolicy.description: Fine-grained boundary rule dictating who may read the claim proposition and evidence.
